summary: State-machine lifecycle reset that zeroes state slots, restores a saved backup value, and optionally re-registers a callback. Before resetting, a caller-supplied output pointer a3 receives the current callback-result slot a1[15]. The current state code *a1 selects optional callbacks: states 4/5 invoke a function pointer stored at a2+36 with arguments (*(a2+40), a1[3]); state 6 calls IndirectCallViaVTable0x24(a1[1], a2). After resetting, if the stored callback pointer a1[14] is non-null it is invoked with (0, 0, 0) and its result is stored back into a1[15] and at a2+48, becoming the return value. On the per-frame path.

operations.description: If a3 is non-null, write the current callback-result slot a1[15] into *a3.
If the state code *a1 is 4 or 5, invoke the function pointer stored at a2+36 with arguments (*(_DWORD*)(a2+40), a1[3]).
If the state code *a1 is 6, call IndirectCallViaVTable0x24(a1[1], a2) — an indirect call through vtable offset 0x24.
Save the backup value a1[10] (field this+0x28), reset the state to 0, then restore the saved value into both a1[13] and a1[12] (field this+0x30 written by the restore).
Zero the state slots a1[7] and a1[8].
Load the callback pointer a1[14]; if non-null, call it with (0, 0, 0) and store the returned pointer into a1[15] and at a2+48.
Return the (possibly updated) callback pointer; returns null when no callback was stored.
Called by ArithmeticComparison_5620 (0x00535620), sub_5357E0 (0x005357E0), MultiBlockAllocator (0x00537070) and TripleVTableCall (0x00537CE0) to reset state and refresh the callback.
